messages.content:
You answer a question about machines at work (law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, company and plant
documents) using ONLY the numbered passages given. Each passage is headed by its document, its place and its rank.

Rules:
- Use only the passages. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- Answer only if a passage states the answer for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the same article
  and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline). A passage about a neighbouring subject does not
  answer the question: then the kind is "unknown" and the value is null. A question about something that happened
  (the date of the last check, whether something is overdue today) is "unknown" unless a passage records that event.
- A passage marked "corrected by the corrigendum" already shows the corrected wording: reason with it. The old
  wording, given in the mark, is no longer valid.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the passages, one by one. A repeal or an
  application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a date is still fully in
  force on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does not yet bind on earlier days.
- When passages of different rank disagree, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's manual,
  then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.) wins over a
  ministerial decree (DM). Say which one wins.
- A row of a table belongs to the thing named in that same row. Read the row of the item asked about, not a
  neighbouring row. When the question itself states a condition ("if it were in regular use", "built in 2017"),
  reason with that condition.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / by which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "how often / for how
  long / within what time" is "duration"; "can / may / is / does / must" is "boolean"; "which / what (several
  things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition is "text" (one short sentence naming every element asked for).
- Point at the evidence: for every passage you rely on, copy word for word the sentence, or the table row, that
  states what you use. Copy exactly, without changing a character; do not join text from two places.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "what the passages say and how it leads to the answer, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y", "P6M", "P45D", "PT1H" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "evidence": [{"passage": <number>, "quote": "<copied exactly from that passage>"}]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: What is the maximum amount of the penalty applicable in Italy, on 1 February 2027, to a manufacturer infringing Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

Passages:
[0] REG, Annex V, Part B, point 9 — rank: law
9. Additional information: Signed for and on behalf of: … (place and date of issue): (name, function) (signature): ( 1 ) It is optional for the manufacturer to assign a number to the declaration of conformity. ( 2 ) It is optional to assign a number to the declaration of conformity. ( 3 ) Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 June 2023 on machinery and repealing Directive 2006/42/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council and Council Directive 73/361/EEC ( OJ L 165, 29.6.2023, p. 1 ).

[1] REG, Art. 50(1) — rank: law
Article 50 Penalties. 1. Member States shall lay down the rules on penalties applicable to infringements by economic operators of this Regulation and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are implemented. The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive and may include criminal penalties for serious infringements.

[2] eu-reg-2024-1689, Recital 168 — rank: law
(168) Compliance with this Regulation should be enforceable by means of the imposition of penalties and other enforcement measures. Member States should take all necessary measures to ensure that the provisions of this Regulation are implemented, including by laying down effective, proportionate and dissuasive penalties for their infringement, and to respect the ne bis in idem principle. In order to strengthen and harmonise administrative penalties for infringement of this Regulation, the upper limits for setting the administrative fines for certain specific infringements should be laid down. When assessing the amount of the fines, Member States should, in each individual case, take into account all relevant circumstances of the specific situation, with due regard in particular to the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement and of its consequences and to the size of the provider, in particular if the provider is an SME, including a start-up. The European Data Protection Supervisor should have the power to impose fines on Union institutions, agencies and bodies falling within the scope of this Regulation.

[3] eu-reg-2016-425, Art. 45(1) — rank: law
Article 45 Penalties. 1. Member States shall lay down the rules on penalties applicable to infringements by economic operators of the provisions of this Regulation. Such rules may include criminal penalties for serious infringements. The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive. Member States shall notify those rules to the Commission by 21 March 2018, and shall notify it without delay of any subsequent amendment affecting them.

[4] eu-reg-2023-988, Art. 44(1) — rank: law
Article 44 Penalties. 1. Member States shall lay down the rules on penalties applicable to infringements of this Regulation that impose obligations on economic operators and providers of online marketplaces and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are implemented in accordance with national law.

[5] eu-reg-2016-425, Art. 45(2) — rank: law
Article 45 Penalties. 2. Member States shall take all measures necessary to ensure that their rules on penalties applicable to infringements by economic operators of the provisions of this Regulation are enforced.

[6] eu-reg-2016-425, Recital 55 — rank: law
(55) Member States should lay down rules on penalties applicable to infringements of this Regulation and ensure that those rules are enforced. The penalties provided for should be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

[7] REG, Recital 82 — rank: law
(82) Member States should lay down rules on penalties applicable to infringements of this Regulation and ensure that those rules are implemented. The penalties provided for should be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

[8] eu-reg-2024-1689, Art. 113 — rank: law
Article 113 Entry into force and application This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union . It shall apply from 2 August 2026. However: (a) Chapters I and II shall apply from 2 February 2025; (b) Chapter III Section 4, Chapter V, Chapter VII and Chapter XII and Article 78 shall apply from 2 August 2025, with the exception of Article 101; (c) Article 6(1) and the corresponding obligations in this Regulation shall apply from 2 August 2027.

[9] REG, Annex V, Part B, point 5 — rank: law
5. A sentence declaring which essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 of the European Parliament and of the Council ( 3 ) are applied and fulfilled and that the relevant technical documentation was drawn-up in accordance with Annex IV, Part B, and, where appropriate, a sentence declaring the conformity of the partly completed machinery with other relevant Union harmonisation legislation.

[10] eu-dir-2014-35, Art. 24 — rank: law
Article 24 Penalties Member States shall lay down rules on penalties, applicable to infringements by economic operators of the provisions of national law adopted pursuant to this Directive and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are enforced. Such rules may include criminal penalties for serious infringements. The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

[11] eu-dir-2014-34, Art. 40 — rank: law
Article 40 Penalties Member States shall lay down rules on penalties applicable to infringements by economic operators of the provisions of national law adopted pursuant to this Directive and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are enforced. Such rules may include criminal penalties for serious infringements. The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

[12] eu-dir-2014-33, Art. 43 — rank: law
Article 43 Penalties Member States shall lay down rules on penalties applicable to infringements by economic operators of the provisions of national law adopted pursuant to this Directive and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are enforced. Such rules may include criminal penalties for serious infringements. The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

[13] eu-dir-2014-30, Art. 42 — rank: law
Article 42 Penalties Member States shall lay down rules on penalties applicable to infringements by economic operators of the provisions of national law adopted pursuant to this Directive and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are enforced. Such rules may include criminal penalties for serious infringements. The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.
